title: cgroups v2 cpu.max
description: The unified hierarchy’s cpu.max takes quota and period in microseconds, the standard way to pin containers. It enforces 100000 100000 (1 CPU) (quota/period); the demo runs a usage of 85000 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: systemd MemoryMax
description: systemd translates MemoryMax into the cgroup memory.max knob per service with clean OOM accounting. It enforces 512M (MB); the demo runs a usage of 420 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Docker --memory
description: Docker’s --memory flag sets the container cgroup limit; --memory-swap extends it to swap. It enforces 1g (MB); the demo runs a usage of 900 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Kubernetes limits
description: Pod resource limits are enforced by the kubelet via cgroups; exceeding memory triggers OOMKill. It enforces 256Mi (MiB); the demo runs a usage of 200 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: ulimit -v virtual memory
description: The classic per-process address-space cap; exceeding it makes malloc fail instead of growing. It enforces 1048576 KB (KB); the demo runs a usage of 800000 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: setrlimit RLIMIT_CPU
description: RLIMIT_CPU sends SIGXCPU then SIGKILL when a process burns its CPU budget — the original time cap. It enforces 60 seconds (seconds); the demo runs a usage of 45 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: seccomp-bpf syscall filter
description: seccomp-bpf caps which syscalls a process may invoke, shrinking the kernel attack surface. It enforces 44 syscalls allowed (syscalls); the demo runs a usage of 30 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: wasmtime fuel metering
description: Fuel counts down per executed instruction; when it hits zero the WASM instance traps deterministically. It enforces 1M fuel units (fuel); the demo runs a usage of 750000 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 --max-old-space-size
description: Caps the old-generation heap in megabytes; Node’s default is ~2 GB on 64-bit. It enforces 2048 MB (MB); the demo runs a usage of 1500 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: JVM -Xmx
description: -Xmx sets the maximum Java heap; allocation beyond it throws OutOfMemoryError instead of paging. It enforces 4g (MB); the demo runs a usage of 3000 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Erlang +P max processes
description: +P caps the BEAM process count so a fork-bomb-style bug cannot exhaust the VM. It enforces 1M processes (processes); the demo runs a usage of 120000 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Cloudflare Workers CPU time
description: Workers get ~10-50 ms CPU per request on the free tier; overruns throw, they never queue. It enforces 50 ms (ms); the demo runs a usage of 32 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: prlimit at runtime
description: prlimit adjusts another running process’s rlimits without restart — caps applied live. It enforces nofile 1024 (fds); the demo runs a usage of 800 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: systemd CPUQuota
description: CPUQuota=50% pins a service to half a core across the whole machine, enforced by the scheduler. It enforces 50% (percent); the demo runs a usage of 40 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: cgroup io.max
description: io.max throttles block-device bandwidth per cgroup with rbps/wbps/riops/wiops keys. It enforces 10 MB/s (MB/s); the demo runs a usage of 7 against the cap.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
